searchText: I am unaware if anything has done such research but do anybody know how many validators gets changed per epoch? I am quite sure it is a fixed number but cannot find any literature on the topic i guess it is mostly attestations duties rewards but wondering if i may missing something You mean the validator structure? Rewards do not alter the validators directly Ah probably too late there, I'll assume you meant the validator structure. Rewards will typically not change them as most validators are active and already have a maximum effective balance. Leaking validators from time to time will drop their effective balance and thus change. BLS to execution address changes, exits, slashings, top up deposits (of validators with less than 32 ETH effective balance) etc will change the validator structure. These are not fixed per epoch
